Hi all,

Quick technical breakdown from the runtime/SCIM side — apologies for the long note but want to be explicit:

1) SCIM v2 compatibility
- Redwood Private Control Plane accepts SCIM v2 endpoints for Users and Groups. We implement the core endpoints: /Users, /Groups, and membership handling via group.members. We do not support PATCH operations that alter schemas; PUT/POST and GET/DELETE for resources are standard.
- Rate limiting: default provisioning throughput is 10 req/s per tenant, burstable to 50 req/s for short windows. We can increase for enterprise contracts.

2) Group -> role mapping
- Mapping is configurable in the Private CP admin UI (we provide a mapping table that maps incoming group.displayName to an internal role slug). Customers can also supply a SCIM entitlement attribute and we can map that to roles at ingestion time.
- If you want Redwoods-managed mapping for the PoC, we can pre-seed a mapping: Acme-admins -> admin, Acme-sre -> infra, Acme-readers -> viewer.

3) SAML metadata and attributes
- The attached sso-saml-metadata.xml is the SP metadata we publish. For SAML assertions we recommend: nameID = email, attribute: groups -> urn:oid:1.2.840.113556.1.4.1941 (or groups attribute name you already use).

4) Attestation and short-notice evidence
- We can provide a Private CP attestation package that includes:
  * control narrative for access control / provisioning (summary doc)
  * sample audit log export (redacted) showing provisioning events for group mapping ops
  * network topology diagram for Private CP (VPC peering/endpoint config)
- Delivery expectation: we can hand over the narrative + sample logs within 5 business days; a formal SOC2 report requires longer (we can reference our hosted SOC2 and supply crosswalks for Private CP).

Next steps suggested:
- Acme to confirm desired group->role mapping for PoC (list of group names).
- Set 30-min technical call to walk SCIM mapping and test endpoints (I can join Wed afternoon).

I attached a compact CSV example of the SCIM attributes we expect (scim-schema-v2.csv) and the SP metadata.

- Aditya
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Runtime
